title: Toy block with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow under block -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#1a3a5c' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- block bottom face -->
  <polygon points='22,70 50,82 78,70 78,68 50,80 22,68' fill='#cc2222'/>
  
  <!-- block right face -->
  <polygon points='78,30 78,68 50,80 50,42' fill='#dd3333'/>
  
  <!-- block left face -->
  <polygon points='22,30 22,68 50,80 50,42' fill='#ee4444'/>
  
  <!-- block top face -->
  <polygon points='22,30 50,18 78,30 50,42' fill='#ff5555'/>
  
  <!-- letter A on left face -->
  <polygon points='32,48 36,48 36,60 32,60' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  
  <!-- smiling face on right face -->
  <!-- face background circle area (implied by face features) -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='48' r='3.5' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='48' r='3.5' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='59' cy='47' r='1.2' fill='#aaddff'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='47' r='1.2' fill='#aaddff'/>
  
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M56 56 Q64 66 72 56' stroke='#1a1a2e' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#ff8888' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#ff8888' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- top face highlights for depth -->
  <polygon points='26,31 50,20 74,31 50,40' fill='#ff7777' opacity='0.4'/>
  
  <!-- star decoration on top face -->
  <polygon points='50,24 52,29 57,29 53,32 55,37 50,34 45,37 47,32 43,29 48,29' fill='#ffdd00'/>
</svg>
